item.title: Maintaining Public Infrastructure
item.description: Practise explaining which municipal repairs take priority, how planned work affects residents, and how cities keep essential services running.

children.definition: Upkeep that was due earlier but was postponed and still needs to be done.
children.example: The facilities team set aside part of next year's budget to tackle deferred maintenance at the public swimming pool.
children.translation_ru: отложенные работы по техническому обслуживанию и ремонту
children.translation_uz: keyinga qoldirilgan texnik xizmat va taʼmirlash ishlari

children.definition: A systematic evaluation of the physical state of an asset and the extent of any deterioration.
children.example: A condition assessment of the pedestrian bridge found corrosion beneath the deck.

children.definition: To sort cases by urgency so that those needing immediate attention are dealt with first.
children.example: After the storm, dispatchers triaged reports of blocked drains and sent the first crews to streets where water was entering homes.

children.definition: A temporary action taken to deal with a problem until a lasting solution is available.
children.example: The city installed temporary lighting at the crossing as a stopgap measure while it waited for a replacement cable.

children.definition: A scheduled period when a utility supply or system will be completely unavailable to affected users.
children.example: The water utility announced a planned outage from midnight to 4 a.m. to replace a valve.
children.translation_uz: kommunal taʼminot uzilishi yoki tizim ishdan toʻxtatilishi oldindan rejalashtirilgan vaqt oraligʻi

children.definition: An interruption to normal operations that reduces or stops what users can access.
children.example: The lane closure caused a service disruption on two bus routes, with buses running every 30 minutes instead of every 10.
children.translation_uz: xizmat odatdagidan cheklangan holda koʻrsatilishi yoki vaqtincha toʻxtashi

children.definition: The introduction of a new system or arrangement in successive stages.
children.example: The phased rollout of the new parking payment system began in two municipal garages and expanded to the others the following month.

children.definition: To put newly installed equipment or a system into regular operation after checking that it works as intended.
children.example: Engineers commissioned the new floodgate after checking that it could open and close under both automatic and manual control.

children.definition: A possible future event or situation that may require a response different from the one originally intended.
children.example: Ice forming before the gritters could finish their routes was a contingency the winter operations team had prepared for.
children.translation_ru: возможная ситуация, которая может потребовать изменения плана
children.translation_uz: yuz berishi ehtimoli bor va rejani oʻzgartirishni talab qilishi mumkin boʻlgan holat

children.definition: The continued availability of a public function during a disruption or change.
children.example: The council maintained service continuity by moving its permit counter to a nearby library while the municipal offices were rewired.

children.definition: The provision of additional components or connections so that a system can keep working if one fails.
children.example: A second communications link provides redundancy for the traffic control centre if the main link fails.
children.translation_uz: asosiy qism ishdan chiqsa, uning vazifasini bajara oladigan zaxira qismlar yoki ulanishlar mavjudligi

children.definition: To direct traffic or a flow away from its usual route and along another one.
children.example: Crews diverted wastewater through a temporary pipe while they repaired a damaged section of the sewer.

children.definition: A chain of breakdowns in which one fault causes other connected parts or systems to stop working.
children.example: A faulty switch triggered a cascading failure as neighbouring circuits overloaded and shut down in turn.
children.translation_uz: bitta nosozlikdan boshlanadigan va oʻzaro bogʻlangan qismlarning ketma-ket ishdan chiqishi bilan davom etadigan jarayon

children.definition: The number of years for which a structure or system is designed to remain fit for use with the planned maintenance.
children.example: The engineers set a fifty-year design life for the replacement bridge deck, with routine inspections throughout that period.
collocations: reach the end of its design life
